summary_1line: Rama receives gifts from his uncle’s envoy Gargya and is asked to conquer the Gandharva land on the Sindhu, assigning the task to Bharata.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama walks out of Ayodhya with his retinue to greet the sage Gargya arriving with thousands of horses and lavish gifts.
The sage Gargya stands in Rama’s court describing the fertile Gandharva land by the Sindhu River and urging its conquest.
